scripts.dev: firebase emulators:exec --ui --project demo-neon-snake --only firestore --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit=.emulator-data "npm run dev:apps"
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently --kill-others -n api,dashboard,game "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w dashboard" "npm run dev:local -w neon-snake-main"
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w dashboard && npm run test -w neon-snake-main
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-neon-snake-test --only firestore "node --test backend/test/integration.test.js"
scripts.build: npm run build -w dashboard && npm run build -w neon-snake-main
scripts.format: prettier --write backend dashboard scripts firebase*.json firestore.indexes.json package.json README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check backend dashboard scripts firebase*.json firestore.indexes.json package.json README.md
